title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 060 ]

blocks.text: Have you ever hurt another person? If so, get in touch with the person you wronged, and ask for forgiveness in all sincerity. You must apologize for that hurt. Promise yourself now to carry it out immediately. Even after many years, it’s still possible to find people. If the person has died or really can’t be found, you can make a contribution in some way to help others who have suffered from similar acts. If your determination is firm, clear, and sincere, then you will be able to put that emotion and memory aside and find peace of mind.

readingSentences.english: Have you ever hurt another person?
readingSentences.korean: 당신은 다른 사람에게 해를 끼친 적이 있는가?

readingSentences.english: If so, get in touch with the person you wronged, and ask for forgiveness in all sincerity.
readingSentences.korean: 만약 그렇다면, 당신이 해를 끼쳤던 사람에게 연락을 하여, 매우 진실하게 용서를 요청하라.

readingSentences.english: You must apologize for that hurt.
readingSentences.korean: 당신은 그 피해에 대해 사과해야만 한다.

readingSentences.english: Promise yourself now to carry it out immediately.
readingSentences.korean: 그것을 즉시 수행하겠다고 지금 자신에게 약속하라.

readingSentences.english: Even after many years, it’s still possible to find people.
readingSentences.korean: 여러 해가 지난후에도, 사람들을 찾는 것이 여전히 가능하다.

readingSentences.english: If the person has died or really can’t be found, you can make a contribution in some way to help others who have suffered from similar acts.
readingSentences.korean: 만약 그 사람이 죽었거나 실제로 찾을 수 없다면, 당신은 유사한 행위로부터 고통을 겪은 다른 사람들을 도와주는 방식으로 기여할 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: If your determination is firm, clear, and sincere, then you will be able to put that emotion and memory aside and find peace of mind.
readingSentences.korean: 만약 당신의 결정이 확고하고, 명쾌하며, 진실하다면, 당신은 그 감정과 기억을 제쳐두고 마음의 평화를 찾을 수 있을 것이다.
